main_text.p: Ps. 78.17. pro לַהַמְרוֹת Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. מָרָה
מְרַזַּח curator funebris, item, מִרְזָח luxus funebris, constr. מִרְזַח, No. f. m. Rad. רָזַח inusit. רָזַח
מְרִיחַ latitudo, & מְרְחָק longinquitas, No. f. m. Rad. רָחַב dilatari, & רָחַק procul esse.
מְרֻחָם misericors; Part. Piel, f. m. R. רַחַם.
מְרַחֶפֶת movens se, Part. Piel, f. f. R. רָחַף.
מָרַט extersus est, præt. Pual, 3. f. m. & מֹרָט vel, מוּרָט depilatus, Part. Pual, vel No. Part. f. m. Rad. מָרַט depilavit.
מָרְטָה expo[?]lita est, præt. Pual, 3. f. f. Rad. מֹרָטָה
לִמְרָטָה ad expoliendum, Infin. Kal, præf. & parag. Rad. מָרַט.
מָרִי, & מְרִי rebellio, No. f. m. R. מָרָה rebellavit.
מְרִיאִים saginatum, מְרִיאֵיכֶם pingues, מְרִיאֵיכֶם vestri, No. f. & pl. m. aff. R. מְרָא.
מְרִיב contendens; מְרִיבִי contendentes, מְרִיבָיו cum eo, Part. Hiph. f. m. & pl. m. aff. R. רוּב litigavit.
מְרִיבָה nomen loci, contentio, No. f. fæm. Rad. רוּב.
מָרִיד, vel מוּרִיד demittens, Part. Hiph. f. m. Rad. יָרַד.
מְרִיבְךָ rebellio tua, בְּמְרִיכֶם rebellione sua, No. f. m. מְרִי, aff. Rad. מָרָה rebellavit.
מְרִים amari, No. pl. m. à f. m. מַר amarus, Rad. מָרַר amarum esse.
מְרִים tollens, מְרִימֵי tollentes, מְרִימָיו tollentes eum, Part. Hiph. f. m. & pl. m. aff. רוּם.

page.notes: Hebrew words are transcribed from the scan with diacritics simplified where the print is blurred; check Hebrew vowel points and the forms marked [?] against the original. The page number at top right is damaged and is not legible. The "expolita" line is partly obscured by a blot and has been marked. The Latin text uses long s, which is given here as plain s. The left-page entry "Ps. 78.17." is printed as "78.17." with a preceding abbreviation; the printed form is kept as far as it can be read. The catchword is the first word of the next page.
